source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
4. All PWR_GB_HSC1~PWR_GB_HSC10 should get pass result.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not directly runnable with a single stock high-level command: PWR_GB_HSC1~PWR_GB_HSC10 requires raw/implementation-specific IPMI bytes + exact expected output which the library has not specified; give exact bytes/result to run.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED because HSC and stimulus contract were undefined.

original_test_intent: Exercise the ten GPU-baseboard hot-swap-controller power channels and verify each HSC sensor, protection response and recovery under a causally relevant load.
original_method: Boot the OS, load the related device stack, apply module stress and read the ten HSC power sensors through IPMI.
manual_activity: Engineer defines the HSC topology and validates the safe load; automation can execute the approved workload and sample all ten controllers.
required_inputs: Approved workload coupled to the HSC domains
safety_requirements: Verify hot-swap and power-domain limits before loading GPUs.
Monitor all HSCs, GPUs, PSU redundancy and temperature.
Stop on current, voltage, thermal or controller fault; no automatic retry.
Use no guessed raw command and preserve first failure.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, automate baseline/load/recovery and correlate each HSC with downstream device power and SEL.
Do not assume HSC means a GPU sensor or issue verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its placeholder correctly prevents an undocumented raw command but supplies no executable coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the platform-documented HSC telemetry plus mapped downstream load evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Ten HSC channels, OS/driver/stress concept, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each HSC to its downstream domain, baseline it, apply approved domain load, correlate current/power/SEL/protection, then verify recovery.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/SDR, HSC firmware, driver and workload versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform power-tree and HSC telemetry/limit specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes HSC ownership and causal load explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ensures ten distinct channels are exercised.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Overload may trip a hot-swap controller or remove GPU power.

project_override_considerations: A project-specific subset is reportable only as that subset; it cannot claim all ten source channels.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The copied GPU-driver wording is incomplete but compatible with HSCs serving GPU domains once the topology is supplied; it does not force a contradictory target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: HSC definition, command and safe workload are project inputs. Manual setup followed by automatable workload and collection is PARTIAL.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds power-tree causality and per-controller coverage.

review_improvement: Transforms a generic sensor-change check into a ten-domain hot-swap-controller correlation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source names a finite ten-channel power matrix. Once that matrix and a safe causal workload are approved, stimulus and evidence capture are automatable despite engineer-owned setup.
